name: keyboard-cat
description: Privacy-first Windows and macOS keyboard companion
author: Keyboard Cat

scripts.build: node scripts/extra-sprites.cjs && node scripts/atlas.cjs && node scripts/dog-sprites.cjs && node scripts/cat-sprites.cjs && node scripts/native.cjs && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.dist: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis portable --publish never && node scripts/clean-old-releases.cjs win
scripts.sprites: node scripts/sprites.cjs && node scripts/extra-sprites.cjs && node scripts/atlas.cjs && node scripts/dog-sprites.cjs && node scripts/cat-sprites.cjs
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis portable --publish never && node scripts/clean-old-releases.cjs win
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --arm64 --x64 --publish never && node scripts/clean-old-releases.cjs mac
